messages.text: Rename this label to "Your first name"

agent.managerSummary:
The label is pulled live from your Wix form, so it has to be renamed in the Wix dashboard — editing code would freeze the binding. Rename it [here](https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35) and the page will show "Your first name" automatically.
Dispatched to a new /contact lane to rename the label to "Your first name".

lanes.name: /contact
lanes.summary:
I'm not making any file changes. The "First name" label on `/contact` comes from the Wix Forms dashboard via the binding `{contact.firstNameD142.label}`, and the `wix-forms` contract's editing guide explicitly says never to replace that binding with a literal (it would freeze the content and break the form's data flow). There is no `wix-forms` update action exposed, so the correct action is to point you to the Wix dashboard to rename the label there — the page will then render "Your first name" automatically.

Rename the label here (First name field of the "ContactMyForm" form):
https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35

No code was changed, so `yarn validate` isn't needed for this edit — but if you'd like, I can run it to confirm the page is still healthy.
